_note: Coin purse widget (Lib/CoinBox), in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 255; opacities 0 to 1, alphas (_alpha) 0 to 255; scales are factors of the pill's coin icon.

pill._note: the box a caller that passes none gets: w x h, right_margin px in from the screen's right edge, y from the top; its shadow is the same pill, moved by (shadow_dx, shadow_dy)

icon._note: the coin on the pill: its size and its gap from the pill's left edge

fallback_coin._note: the drawn coin when the Coin shared texture is missing: a rim px rim, a red top half, a blue bottom half and a glint at (glint_dx, glint_dy) times the inner radius up and left of the middle, glint_size times it across (at least glint_min px)

text._note: labels are anchored by their middle, where the glyph box draws its ink high: they move down nudge times their font size. right_inset: the balance and the line above it, from the pill's right edge; above_dy: that line (price, bonus) over the pill's top

flying_coin._note: a flying coin's scale: scale_x wide, wobbling by wobble (it reads as a spin), scale_y high
